title: Transcript search bar placement + VK Video header layering
changes: Search bar is inserted directly after [data-testid="time"] inside .controls-left and before .controls-right.
Search control now works in VK Video shadow DOM and is injected on the first active-video pass as well as subsequent refreshes.
Transcript bootstrap now targets the exact VK Video player root, waits for subtitle tracks to appear, and retries delayed transcript loading.
Video ID detection is made more robust from the VK Video URL.
VK Video header receives a higher stacking level so the player cannot paint over the top navigation while scrubbing/scrolling.
